name: higgsfield-generate
cost: The skills are free (MIT). Higgsfield's own prices are not stated in the README.
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents that load Markdown skills
short: Lets your AI agent make images, videos, 3D models and audio through Higgsfield AI, including branded ads.
what: This skill wraps the `higgsfield` command line tool so your agent can submit jobs to Higgsfield's models. It picks a default model for each job, such as GPT Image 2.6 for images and Seedance 2.5 for video. It also runs Marketing Studio for branded ad videos with avatars and products, and Virality Predictor, which scores a finished video's hook and attention.
who: Marketers and creators who already use or want to use Higgsfield for ads and visual content. If you don't want a Higgsfield account, skip it.
needs: The Higgsfield CLI, which the install sets up
GitHub CLI v2.90 or newer, only for the `gh skill install` route

steps.title: Install the skills
steps.text: The README's recommended route. Each install method also handles the Higgsfield CLI install and sign-in.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: If `higgsfield account status` says you are not signed in, run this yourself.

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text: Say "generate an image" or "make a video" with your prompt. The agent replies with the media link from the CLI.

watch: If the CLI is missing, the skill tells your agent to install it by piping a script from GitHub straight into `sh`: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/higgsfield-ai/cli/main/install.sh | sh`. Read the script first.
Your agent gets to run shell commands for this skill, and local files you pass are uploaded to Higgsfield.
Jobs run on Higgsfield's service. The skill tells the agent not to pre-estimate cost and to prefer the quality default unless you ask for cheaper.
